description:
Pre-loading is now available for everyone who has pre-ordered Grand Theft Auto VI digitally. Players who pre-ordered the code-in-box version can also activate their code and begin pre-loading as soon as it’s received. If you still have yet to pre-order, now’s the time to make sure you're prepared for November 19. 

The new single, “Blood In Your Eyes” by Tove Lo, is also available on Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, the official soundtrack which is currently available to pre-save on all major music streaming services and up for pre-order on vinyl or CD. Listen to “Blood In Your Eyes” now.

description:
Pre-order now to get the Legacy Costume pack.

https://www.xbox.com/games/store/edge-of-memories/9p43b4srjk0s

What’s a JRPG with an animated opening? Nothing, that’s what!

The Edge of Memories opening video was directed by Yukio Takatsu (Persona 3) and voiced in English by Marion Schneider (Edge of Eternity™, Temtem™ series) and in Japanese by Emi Evans (NieR™ / NieR: Automata™). 

Explore the continent of Averis in an upcoming action-RPG that draws on anime visuals and the hack-and-slash games of the 360 era. Save a doomed world with your companions as you fight against the Corrosion, a mysterious disease that reshapes the world and its inhabitants.

Edge of Memories is coming to XBOX Series X|S on December 3rd!
